title: They say it's the most haunted lighthouse in the world.
hook: They say it's the most haunted lighthouse in the world.
cta: What secrets hide within its walls? Follow us to find out more!

segments.narration: Lone beam of light pierces darkness.
segments.image_prompt: A solitary lighthouse beam cutting through dense fog, waves crashing against rocky shore, moonlight barely visible above clouds.
Close-up on flickering lighthouse light, shadows moving within beam, mysterious whispers barely audible, moonlight casting eerie patterns on walls inside the lighthouse.
Dark, abandoned lighthouse interior with broken windows and scattered debris, old maps and papers covered in water stains, doors creaking softly as wind howls outside.
Fog swirled around the lighthouse, a figure seen briefly in the distance running towards it, then vanishing, strange symbols etched into ancient stone.
